title: Credential Reuse Methodology
description: Spray each new credential set in a fixed order
detail:
After obtaining a set of credentials (web admin/db/ssh), try them in order:
1. Other entry points on the same site (front-end users, APIs)
2. SSH: the target host + same usernames on the internal subnet as root/user
3. Databases: mysql/mssql/redis admin accounts
4. Windows: SMB/WMI (impacket suite)
5. Middleware management consoles
6. git/svn credentials → code repository → hardcoded keys
For each cred fact, record username/password/source/hit (where it worked) so the commander can dispatch spray intents accordingly.
Password mutations: prefix/suffix 1/123/!, year, company abbreviation.
